mod.biosphere.name: TOMC-Biosphere
mod.biosphere.description: A data-driven ecology simulation: predation, eating and random-tick succession.
config.biosphere.title: TOMC-Biosphere Config
config.biosphere.readonly: Read-only: this page is provided by the server and cannot be edited here.
config.biosphere.passiveAttackEnabled.to:
Loads the attack/avoid relationships in biosphere_food_chain/*.json.
Changes apply after reloading the world.
config.biosphere.environmentalChangeEnab:
Loads the succession rules in biosphere_environmental_change/*.json.
Changes apply after reloading the world.
config.biosphere.spawnDataEnabled.toolti:
Loads the natural-spawn entries in biosphere_spawns/*.json.
Changes apply on next game start.
config.biosphere.mushroomConversionChanc:
Chance that a cow converts to a mooshroom after eating mycelium.
Value is in [0, 1].
config.biosphere.meleeDamage.tooltip: Damage dealt by the added melee attack.
config.biosphere.meleeSpeed.tooltip: Speed multiplier used when chasing relation targets.
config.biosphere.meleeCooldownTicks.tool:
Ticks between two melee attacks.
20 ticks = 1 second.
config.biosphere.avoidSpeed.tooltip: Speed multiplier used when fleeing relation threats.
config.biosphere.endermanHoldableOverrid:
When on: endermen ignore the datapack's #minecraft:enderman_holdable tag
and use this mod's whitelist instead — every block in the checked
categories can be picked up.

Always excluded: beds, doors, double plants (multiblock structures).
Always applied: the #biosphere:enderman_holdable_blacklist, whatever this switch says.
config.biosphere.endermanHoldableTabs.to:
Creative-inventory categories whose blocks endermen may pick up.
Default: Natural Blocks only.
The list is empty until you are in a world; it fills in once you enter one.
config.biosphere.endermanHoldableTabs.no:
Category list not loaded yet: enter any world first, then come back to this page.
(The server is unaffected — it expands the whitelist on its own.)
config.biosphere.creefernOverride.toolti:
false (default): the auto-detected result is used.
true: the force-override value below decides instead.
config.biosphere.creefern.on: -> Feature enabled: creepers also target mobs whose health falls in the range below.
config.biosphere.creefern.off.notDetecte:
-> Feature disabled: creefern was not found, so the health range below has no effect.
(Use the "Override creefern detection" switch above to force it on.)
config.biosphere.creefern.off.forced:
-> Feature disabled: "Force override value" is false, so the health range below has no effect.
(Set "Force override value" above to true to enable it.)
config.biosphere.creefernMinHealth.toolt: Creepers target mobs with current health above this value.
config.biosphere.creefernMaxHealth.toolt: Creepers target mobs with current health at or below this value.
